items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: I'd sit next to Buddy and just listen to him play.

ctx.x: People tell us he was wonderful on the blues like Careless Love, but was he good on other things too, everything? Or what style did he have?

Well, as far as I can remember, I just would sit up there and I used to go up there and listen to those bands play. They used to play in what we call the buzzard roof in these dance halls. We had to go upstairs. Oh yeah, the balcony. Upstairs in the balcony. And I used to go up there just a kid and sit down. I'd sit next to Buddy and just listen to him play.
